goal.en: Recognise irony, understatement and deadpan — and know when they will not survive the journey.
goal.ar: أن تتعرّف على السخرية والتهوين والدعابة الجافة، وأن تعرف متى لا تصل هذه الأساليب سالمة.

thread.title: A message thread between colleagues
thread.text:
RANIA: Just seen the new deadline. The 14th.
TOM: Ah. Well, that's ambitious.
RANIA: Ambitious is one word for it.
TOM: I mean, we could always skip testing entirely. That's never gone wrong before.
RANIA: Ha. Shall I put it to Maha, or will you?
TOM: You do it. She likes you.
RANIA: She likes you too. She just doesn't like the schedule.

text.en: Understatement is a default setting in much English, especially British English. The gap between the mildness of the words and the size of the situation is where the meaning lives.
text.ar: التهوين إعداد افتراضي في كثير من الإنجليزية، ولا سيما البريطانية. والمعنى يسكن في الفجوة بين خفّة الكلمات وضخامة الموقف.

head: Said
Meant
rows: I have one or two concerns.
I object to most of this.
That went about as well as expected.
He's not the most organised person.

text.en: Understatement fails with a reader who does not share the convention. In writing that crosses cultures, state the problem plainly and save the understatement for the tone around it.
text.ar: يخفق التهوين مع قارئ لا يشاركك العرف نفسه. ففي الكتابة العابرة للثقافات اذكر المشكلة صراحةً، واحفظ التهوين للنبرة المحيطة بها.

head: Signal
Example
rows: formal words for a trivial thing
I shall be lodging a formal complaint about the biscuits.
Ambitious is one word for it.
Turns out you need time to do things.

text.en: Irony depends on shared knowledge: the listener must already know the statement is false. Without that, it is simply misinformation delivered confidently.
text.ar: تعتمد السخرية على معرفة مشتركة: على السامع أن يعلم سلفاً أن العبارة غير صحيحة. وبدون ذلك تكون مجرد معلومة خاطئة تُقال بثقة.

text.en: In writing, irony has no tone of voice to carry it. If a sentence would be damaging when read straight, do not risk it in an email.
text.ar: في الكتابة لا تجد السخرية نبرةَ صوت تحملها. فإن كانت الجملة ضارّة لو قُرئت على ظاهرها فلا تغامر بها في بريد إلكتروني.

title.en: Deadpan and the risks it carries

text.en: Deadpan delivers something absurd in a flat, serious register and leaves the audience to notice. It builds rapport quickly — and misfires expensively.
text.ar: تقدّم الدعابة الجافة أمراً عبثياً بنبرة جادّة مسطّحة وتترك للمتلقي أن ينتبه. وهي تبني الألفة سريعاً، لكن إخفاقها مكلف.

head: Context
Deadpan is
rows: in a first meeting with a client
in writing to a large group

text.en: The safest joke points at yourself or at the situation. The moment it points at a person who did not choose to be in it, it stops being a joke to them.
text.ar: أسلم النكات ما وُجّه إلى النفس أو إلى الموقف. فما إن يُوجَّه إلى شخص لم يختر أن يكون طرفاً فيها حتى تكفّ عن كونها نكتة في نظره.

prompt.en: What does Tom mean by “that's ambitious”?
prompt.ar: ماذا يقصد توم بقوله that's ambitious؟

options: The deadline cannot realistically be met.
The deadline is challenging but achievable.
The team should aim higher than this.
The plan shows admirable confidence.

explanation.en: Praise-shaped words for a bad plan. Rania's reply confirms both of them read it that way.
explanation.ar: كلمات في هيئة مدح لخطة سيئة، وردّ رانيا يؤكد أن كليهما فهمها كذلك.

prompt.en: “Ambitious is one word for it.” What is Rania doing?

options: Agreeing while hinting at a blunter word she has not used.
Correcting Tom's choice of vocabulary rather politely.
Saying that ambition is exactly what this project needs.
Asking Tom to explain what he actually meant by the word.

explanation.en: The formula points at the word she is declining to say — and everyone hears it anyway.
explanation.ar: الصيغة تشير إلى الكلمة التي امتنعت عن قولها، ومع ذلك يسمعها الجميع.

prompt.en: A manager writes “I have one or two concerns about the draft.” What is likely true?
prompt.ar: كتب مدير: I have one or two concerns about the draft. ما المرجّح؟

options: There are many concerns, and the draft needs real work.
There are exactly two small points to fix quickly.
The draft is essentially finished and ready to go.
The manager has not actually read the draft yet.

explanation.en: “One or two” is a quantity chosen for politeness, not for accuracy.
explanation.ar: عبارة one or two كمية اختيرت للتهذيب لا للدقة.

prompt.en: Match the understatement with its meaning.

pairs: It went as well as expected.

explanation.en: Each pair is a fixed convention, not a creative choice — which is why they can be learned.
explanation.ar: كل زوج عرف ثابت لا اختيار إبداعي، ولهذا يمكن تعلّمها.

prompt.en: “We could always skip testing. That's never gone wrong before.” What is Tom doing?

options: Using an obviously false claim to show the idea is absurd.
Genuinely proposing that the team skip the testing phase.
Reporting that skipping testing worked well previously.
Asking Rania whether testing has ever caused problems.

explanation.en: Both know skipping testing has gone wrong. The shared knowledge is what makes it irony rather than error.
explanation.ar: كلاهما يعلم أن تخطي الاختبار أخفق من قبل، والمعرفة المشتركة هي ما يجعلها سخرية لا خطأ.

prompt.en: Which signal most reliably marks irony in writing?
prompt.ar: أي إشارة تدل على السخرية في الكتابة بأكبر قدر من الوثوق؟

options: A claim both writer and reader know to be false.
An exclamation mark at the end of the sentence.
A sentence that is noticeably longer than usual.
A formal word placed in an informal message.

explanation.en: Irony runs on shared knowledge. Punctuation and register are hints; the shared falsehood is the mechanism.
explanation.ar: تقوم السخرية على المعرفة المشتركة. فعلامات الترقيم والمستوى إشارات، أما الآلية فهي الكذب المعروف للطرفين.

prompt.en: Which sentence is safe to send to a client you have never met?
prompt.ar: أي جملة يمكن إرسالها بأمان إلى عميل لم تلتقه من قبل؟

options: The timeline is tight; I'd suggest we review it before committing.
Well, that timeline is certainly an ambitious one, isn't it.
We could just skip the testing. That always works out fine.
Sure, four days. What could possibly go wrong with that.

explanation.en: The other three rely on a shared reading you have no reason to assume. Read straight, two of them are agreement.
explanation.ar: الثلاث الأخرى تعتمد على فهم مشترك لا مبرّر لافتراضه، وقراءةً على الظاهر تبدو اثنتان منها موافقة.

prompt.en: A message says: “Great, another meeting about meetings.” What is the writer's attitude?

options: Frustration, expressed through false enthusiasm.
Genuine pleasure at the scheduled meeting.
Neutral confirmation that a meeting exists.
Confusion about what the meeting is for.

explanation.en: “Great” plus a self-evidently tedious noun phrase is the standard shape of this complaint.
explanation.ar: كلمة Great مع عبارة اسمية مملّة بداهةً هي الشكل المعتاد لهذه الشكوى.

prompt.en: When is deadpan humour most likely to misfire?

options: In writing, to a large group who do not know you.
In conversation with colleagues you work with daily.
In a message to a friend of many years.
In a story you are telling about yourself.

explanation.en: No tone of voice, no shared history, and many readers — every safeguard is missing at once.
explanation.ar: لا نبرة صوت، ولا تاريخ مشترك، وقراء كثيرون — تغيب كل الضمانات دفعةً واحدة.

prompt.en: Which joke is safest in a work context?
prompt.ar: أي دعابة أسلم في سياق العمل؟

options: I've read my own draft twice and understood it once.
I've read Sami's draft twice and understood it once.
Whoever wrote this draft should try writing in English.
This draft reads like it was written in a hurry, Sami.

explanation.en: Pointing the joke at yourself costs nothing. The same joke aimed at a colleague is a public judgement.
explanation.ar: توجيه النكتة إلى نفسك لا يكلّف شيئاً، أما توجيهها إلى زميل فحكم علني عليه.

prompt.en: What does the exchange tell you about Rania and Tom's relationship?
prompt.ar: ماذا تخبرك المحادثة عن علاقة رانيا وتوم؟

options: They know each other well enough for irony to be safe.
They are meeting for the first time on this project.
They disagree sharply about the value of testing.
They are both senior to Maha in the organisation.

explanation.en: Neither has to explain the joke, and each picks up the other's tone immediately.
explanation.ar: لا أحد منهما مضطر لشرح النكتة، وكلٌّ يلتقط نبرة الآخر فوراً.

prompt.en: “She likes you too. She just doesn't like the schedule.” What is Rania saying?

options: The problem is the plan, so Tom cannot avoid raising it.
Maha dislikes Tom and he should therefore stay away.
The schedule was designed by Maha and cannot change.
She will raise the issue with Maha herself after all.

explanation.en: She removes his excuse gently: the objection is not personal, so his reluctance has no cover.
explanation.ar: تنزع عذره بلطف: الاعتراض ليس شخصياً، فلم يبقَ لتردّده غطاء.

prompt.en: Say it plainly: “The launch went about as well as expected.” → “The launch ___ badly.”

explanation.en: The understatement and the plain version carry the same information; only the social cost differs.
explanation.ar: التهوين والصيغة الصريحة يحملان المعلومة نفسها، والفارق في الكلفة الاجتماعية فقط.

prompt.en: Which reply signals disagreement without irony?
prompt.ar: أي رد يُظهر الاعتراض دون سخرية؟

options: I don't think the 14th is achievable — here's what worries me.
Sure, the 14th. That's a completely reasonable request.
Oh, the 14th! Why not the 12th while we're at it?
The 14th. Of course. Nothing could go wrong there.

explanation.en: Irony makes a point at a cost; plain disagreement makes the same point and can be answered.
explanation.ar: السخرية توصل الفكرة بكلفة، أما الاعتراض الصريح فيوصلها ويمكن الردّ عليه.

prompt.en: Why is “I was only joking” a poor repair?
prompt.ar: لماذا تُعدّ عبارة I was only joking اعتذاراً ضعيفاً؟

options: It denies the effect rather than addressing it.
It uses a tense that is wrong in this context.
It is too formal for most workplace exchanges.
It repeats the joke that caused the problem.

explanation.en: The listener's response is the fact in question; intent does not undo it. “That came out wrong — I'm sorry” does.
explanation.ar: رد فعل المتلقي هو الواقعة محل النظر، والنيّة لا تلغيها. أما عبارة «خرج كلامي على غير ما أردت، آسف» فتفعل.
